title: 30A Ahh Relax | Beachside 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Come stay in this new, Pet Friendly vacation rental with Gulf Views and located 400 Ft to the Beach
description_expanded: 30A Ahh Relax Coastal Comfort Steps from the Beach Just 400 feet from Fort Panic Beach Access, this pet-friendly 30A retreat offers a prime location, stylish interiors, and thoughtful extras for an effortless vacation. With complimentary bikes, a Gulf-facing patio, and a VIP local experience , it's designed for relaxation and fun by the shore. Unwind in style at 30A Ahh Relax , a beautifully updated 3BR/2BA retreat in Dune Allen. With an oversized covered patio, dog-friendly setup, and included VIP tour at 30A Distilling Co., this home is the perfect blend of coastal charm and convenience-just steps from the sand, dining, and scenic 30A adventures. Home Highlights - Gulf and Lake Views ! - Sleeping for 9 Guests - King suite, queen bedroom, bunk room with twin-over-full + trundle and sleeper sofa - Beach Proximity - Only 400 feet to Fort Panic Beach Access (ADA-accessible, seasonal lifeguards, restrooms, and parking) - Pet Friendly - Up to 2 dogs with pre-approval and fee - Oversized Gulf Facing Covered Patio - Gulf Views, cushioned sofa, jumbo lounger, and outdoor dining with Gulf breezes - Complimentary VIP Tour - $100 value at 30A Distilling Co for up to 9 guests staying in the home. (welcome cocktail, charcuterie, behind-the-scenes tour) - 4 Taxi Bikes Included - Regularly serviced for guest use - Fully Equipped Kitchen - Stainless appliances, coffee maker, and open layout - Washer and Dryer - In-unit laundry for guest convenience - Smart TVs and WIFI - Stream your favorites or stay connected - Parking for 4 Vehicles - Driveway access included (garage access not available) - Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens professionally laundered after every stay Location Perks - 3 min walk to Fort Panic Beach Access (with seasonal beach service) - 4 min walk to famous Stinky's Fish Camp, Stinky's Bait Shack for Sunrise Happy Hour and Cherry Coffee Roasters - 5 min bike ride to Gulf Place shopping, dining, and events - 10 min drive to Publix + local grocery stores Know Before You Go - Entry to the home is on the 2nd floor and requires the use of stairs to enter the home - A mid-stay clean is required for bookings 10+ days (included in rate) - Concierge available for add-ons like beach bonfires, LSV (golf carts), eBikes, and chef services - Pet approval + fee required for up to 2 dogs - Must be 25+ to book - Cameras are present at the home entrances for security ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: Guest Room 1 | Queen Bed, Gulf View, electric fireplace, private entrance to covered patio, TV, adjacent to shared full bath with walk-in shower
Guest Room 2 | Queen Bed, TV, adjacent to shared full bath with walk-in shower
Guest Room 3 | Queen Bed, Gulf View, TV, ceiling fan, adjacent to shared full bath with combo shower/tub
Guest Room 4 | Sleeps 2 in a Twin over Twin Bunk, workspace with desk and monitor available, adjacent to shared full bath with combo shower/tub
Bonus | Queen Sleeper Sofa in the living room

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
